svg.title: Skills and toolkit
svg.desc: Offensive: Metasploit, Burp Suite, SQLMap, Nikto, Gobuster, Hydra, John the Ripper, BeEF, Netcat. Recon: Nmap, Masscan, Shodan, Maltego, theHarvester. Active Directory: BloodHound, CrackMapExec, Impacket, Mimikatz. Web, API, mobile: OWASP Top 10, JWT, MobSF, Frida. Cloud and SIEM: Splunk, Wazuh, Sentinel, QRadar, Sigma, KQL. GRC: ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS.
